title: PC-CROP Federal Accounting — 1C connector protocol contract
purpose: Continue the owner-authorized PC-CROP Federal Accounting programme with the smallest independent Wave 6 slice that is fully buildable without vendor credentials: the provider-neutral local 1C connector protocol contract. This slice defines the exact seven typed commands, self-discovery shape, compatibility profiles, one-time pairing primitive, organization binding checks, sync-state transitions and the /connector/v1 route vocabulary. It creates no live 1C adapter, no external-success claim and no production mutation.
objective: Make the 1C side impossible to widen into arbitrary SQL/code or fake success before persistence and machine-identity routing are added in the next slice.
boundaries: No apps/web, packages, lockfile, Prisma schema, migration, auth, registration, banking, FGIS, production or hosting change.
No 1C vendor protocol is guessed and no adapter is called ADAPTER_READY from this slice.
No universal-1C compatibility claim; UNKNOWN and unsupported/manual fallbacks remain explicit.
No arbitrary SQL, arbitrary code execution, database dump or unrestricted record-read command is representable by the protocol.
Pairing is one-time, expiring and hash-verified; persistence and atomic consumption belong to the next server-side slice.
AUTO_POST stays fail-closed and cannot be enabled by the connector protocol alone.
UNKNOWN is not success and cannot be blindly retried; reconciliation is required first.
Merge and green CI are not production acceptance.
requiredInvariants: The command allowlist is exactly UPSERT_COUNTERPARTY, CREATE_SALES_DRAFT, CREATE_PURCHASE_DRAFT, CREATE_CORRECTION_DRAFT, GET_DOCUMENT_STATUS, PUSH_PAYMENT_STATUS and GET_REFERENCE_CANDIDATES.
A binding names one platform organization and one 1C organization GUID; a GUID not present in discovery is denied.
One database may expose many legal entities, but a machine identity never gains another organization's binding implicitly.
Pairing secrets have bounded TTL, are stored only as salted SHA-256 hashes, and a consumed or expired challenge is refused.
The default posting mode is CREATE_DRAFT; AUTO_POST requires separate explicit accepted evidence outside this protocol.
An unsupported configuration remains UNKNOWN or an explicit manual/export fallback; the protocol never claims any 1C works.
Timeout/unavailability maps to UNKNOWN, never POSTED or success.
A transition out of UNKNOWN requires reconciliation before a retry can be queued.
requiredChecks: existing PC-CROP accounting and security gates
